About these 14 rides

They ride on 6 days of the week; Thursday has the most, with 5; only Wednesday has none. Starts run from 7:30 am to 7:00 pm. After work, 6 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 2. There are 2 rides made for women, trans and femme riders and 1 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
